$comment: Engine/front-end boundary allowlist for docs-internal/ENGINE_MIGRATION_PLAN.md Arc 1. Each row is a packages/core/src file importing @lokascript/semantic, /intent or /i18n, counted per import KIND — static-value is the real debt, static-type and typeof-import erase at build time, dynamic defers. Since Phase C6 of the engine cutover core's root re-exports @hyperfixi/engine, and the only front-end import left is multilingual/ (the front-end side); a front-end import anywhere else fails outright and cannot be added here.

multilingual/index.ts.reason: The front-end entry (`@hyperfixi/core/multilingual`): parse, render and translate over @lokascript/semantic, loaded with one deferred import and typed with type-only queries.
